description:
Prepare to be captivated by Giga, the mighty cut & flared dragon. Towering in presence yet designed for an unexpectedly comfortable fit, Giga balances dominance and adaptability.

At first glance his bold silhouette and commanding flared head might look daunting – but in soft or ultra-soft silicone his shape compresses effortlessly, moulding to your body for an exhilarating stretch that stays comfortable.

Explore Giga in 3D

Spin it, switch between sizes and bases, slide the diameter ring to measure it at any point, compare it with a soda or Monster can, and tap the AR button on your phone to see it at real size in your room.

Why you'll love Giga

  • Cut & flared head for deep, satisfying sensations
  • Scaled, fantasy-inspired detail
  • Compresses and conforms – easier to take than it looks
  • Three sizes, with a suction cup or flat bottom
  • Handmade in Australia from skin-safe silicone – Australian Made Certified

Make it yours

Pick your size, base and density, then list your colours: Small takes 2, Medium 3 and Large 4 (the colour charts are in the gallery). No colours listed? We'll choose a stunning combination for you. Made to order – ships in 2–5 business days in plain, unmarked packaging.

sections.title: Base Options
sections.html:
Suction cup: securely sticks Giga to any smooth, flat surface.

Flat bottom: a clean, flat end.

Switch between bases in the 3D viewer to see each one up close.

sections.title: Materials & Colours
sections.html:
Giga is handmade in Australia from high-grade, skin-safe, soft-touch silicone (choose soft or ultra soft). All our silicone toys are Australian Made Certified.

Colours: list your colours and/or glitters when you order – see the colour charts in the gallery. The charts are a reference guide only: colours shift once mixed into silicone, and every pour is unique. If no colours are listed, we'll select a stunning combination for you.

Small takes 2 colours, Medium 3 and Large 4.

sections.title: Ways to Play
sections.html:
Ride it: choose the suction cup base for hands-free play on any smooth surface.

Take it slow: the soft silicone compresses as you go – start slow and let Giga mould to you.

Whether you're a seasoned adventurer or new to big toys, Giga proves even the fiercest dragon can be tamed.

sizeNote: Measured from our 3D models. Use the diameter ring in the 3D viewer to check the width at any point, or see it at true size in your room with AR.
